description:
About the company
 Our client is a financial services technology company.
 The role
 Raydar is recruiting for this role on behalf of our client. Own the design and delivery of AI-driven features end to end, from backend services and orchestration logic to user-facing interfaces. Work closely with a small, in-person engineering team to ship dependable, well-tested systems and build the measurement tooling that shows whether they are getting better.
 What you'll do
 - Build autonomous software agents that handle complex, multi-step tasks using planning, code execution, search and retrieval.
 - Develop background agents that triage communications, process meetings and draft messages on behalf of users.
 - Create the orchestration layer that connects language models, context, tools, retrieval and business logic reliably.
 - Design interactive interfaces where users and agents collaborate in real time.
 - Build evaluation infrastructure that measures both factual accuracy and subjective, judgment-based quality.
 - Design memory and context systems that capture and evolve an understanding of individual users over time.
 - Account for auditability, compliance and fast-changing datasets in system design.
 Requirements 
 What we're looking for
 - Have shipped AI agents to production that coordinate language models, call external tools and pull in relevant information.
 - Hands-on knowledge of LLM agent frameworks, retrieval-augmented generation, tool calling and prompt engineering.
 - Strong software engineering fundamentals, including APIs, data modeling and system design.
 - Background at a high-growth startup.
 - Comfort working with probabilistic systems and a rigorous, experiment-driven approach to quality.
 - A careful, high-standards mindset where accuracy matters and speed and reliability go together.
 - Kind, direct and low-ego collaboration style, and enthusiasm for working in the office five days a week.
 Bonus points
 - Prior work creating quality-measurement tooling for AI systems whose outputs vary from run to run.
 - Background designing interactive front ends that keep a person involved in automated workflows.
 - Bachelor's degree in Computer Science.
 Benefits 
 Compensation and benefits
 - Base salary: USD 200,000 to 300,000 per year
 - Equity
 Location and work model
 - New York City, NY, United States
 - On-site, 5 days per week in the office
 - Full-time
